threat_event: Ransomware on the laptop encrypts local files and steals downloads and email contents
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptop unencrypted; no MFA on email; built-in antivirus only; no backup of local files; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 laptop; SYS-02 email and files
treatment_plan: Turn on email MFA and full-disk encryption; move files to a business plan with a BAA and versioning; annual security training; P08 runbook

threat_event: Takeover of the personal email account exposes PHI in messages and stored files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on email; PHI kept in a consumer account
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA now; unique passphrase in a password manager; then move to a business plan with a BAA (R-003)

threat_event: Consumer email and file provider handles PHI with no BAA (impermissible disclosure; provider terms the practice cannot control)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Personal consumer account; no BAA available on that plan
treatment_plan: Move to a business-grade email and file plan whose vendor signs a BAA; migrate PHI and delete it from the personal account

threat_event: Theft or loss of the unencrypted laptop exposes cached PHI and downloads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No full-disk encryption; laptop travels between home and office
treatment_plan: Turn on the operating system's built-in full-disk encryption and keep the recovery key offline

threat_event: Patient texts or skin photos on the personal phone are disclosed (lost phone, wrong number, or photo sync to a personal cloud)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patients texted from a personal number; clinical photos stay in the camera roll
treatment_plan: Use the EHR portal or EHR mobile app for messages and photos; turn off photo cloud sync for clinical photos; enable remote wipe

threat_event: Another tenant's device or a nearby attacker on the shared building Wi-Fi attacks the laptop or intercepts traffic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office on the shared building network (separate password; same network)
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; host firewall on
treatment_plan: Install a practice-owned router on a separate network, or use the phone hotspot for practice work

threat_event: Answering service discloses after-hours PHI with no BAA in place
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No BAA; no knowledge of the service's safeguards
treatment_plan: Execute a BAA with the answering service or switch to one that signs

threat_event: Attacker uses the IT consultant's remote-support tool or account to reach the laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote-support tool had unattended access on until 2026-07-23; consultant's own safeguards unreviewed; BAA only since 2026-07-17
existing_controls: BAA signed 2026-07-17; unattended access turned off 2026-07-23
treatment_plan: Owner starts and watches each session; confirm the consultant uses MFA on the tool account; remove the tool when not needed

threat_event: Visit audio sent to a consumer AI scribe app with no BAA; vendor may keep or train on it; visits recorded without patient consent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trial started before any contract, BAA, or consent review
treatment_plan: Do not resume; request deletion from the vendor; document the breach risk assessment with counsel; adopt only a HIPAA-eligible scribe with a BAA (P10)

threat_event: Physician-owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so nobody can reach the EHR, patients, or vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single person holds every role and credential; EHR second factor on one phone; no coverage arrangement
treatment_plan: Coverage arrangement with a nearby physician; sealed recovery codes and emergency access sheet with the owner's attorney; answering service script (P05)

threat_event: EHR vendor outage lasts longer than one clinic day
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); printed next-day schedule
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep printing the next-day schedule

threat_event: Downloaded documents and clinical photos lost to device failure or ransomware with no backup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup of local files or phone photos; photos not always uploaded to the EHR
existing_controls: EHR vendor backs up what is in the EHR
treatment_plan: Upload every clinical photo and document to the EHR the same day; keep other files only in the business file plan with versioning

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized or a breach deadline is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact list, or security training
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact list; annual security training for the owner

threat_event: OCR enforcement after a complaint or breach because no risk analysis or written policies existed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No risk analysis ever performed; no written policies before 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: Keep this register current; review every year and after major changes; retain documents 6 years

threat_event: Hurricane closes the office for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single office; paper and devices on site
existing_controls: EHR is cloud-hosted and reachable from home over a phone hotspot
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop and tablet home when a storm watch is issued
